title: Gates and filing: words do not misclass a gate, workers file no duplicates and add gates with their do map
goal: A brief names a known suite-level failure so a worker files no duplicate bug; a worker runs backlog.py find before it files a bug; the worker role's gate add names a --do per option; a gate question that names a package's upload date, a gitlab/ kb path or a display-only push is no push gate; a gate that lists tokens as a unit noun is class design, not secrets; test_authority holds the secrets class inside each token exception shape; start's host-setup warning stays silent on a rule gate that only names a host
